findings.body: [General] This new section duplicates the review policy and exceptions from `.github/instructions/javaagent.instructions.md:67-82`, including the negative-test guidance. That conflicts with `.github/agents/knowledge/README.md:10-15`, which requires reportable review rules to remain in native instructions instead of being repeated in knowledge articles, and creates two copies that can drift. Keep the canonical rule in the native instruction and limit this article to implementation mechanics or examples that add technical context.

metadata.body:
Make return-type matching opt-in in the javaagent rules. Keep a predicate only when supported usage needs it for method selection or compatibility.

Typed `@Advice.Return`, including return-value replacement, is not sufficient justification. Keep argument-binding rules, but remove the recommendation and example that encourage argument-hierarchy traversal.
